Retro Rattan Holiday. 🎄

The Sunday Mahjong Rattan mat isn't a Christmas mat, but with a red tartan cloth and a ceramic tree lamp, it sure feels like one. Heritage tiles, walnut racks, a holly leaf dice dish and amber glass coasters finish the table.

You don't need to buy a holiday mat. Style what you already have.

Comment and I'll send you the links. 🤍 The whole table is on the blog too (link in bio).
